mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the submit_verdict.go file key or the submitVerdict or submitVerdictLifecycle key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. All three keys are removed. submitVerdictLifecycle is an orchestrator over admitVerdictRequest, submitVerdictUnderReviewLock and rolloverAfterRejection; submitVerdict is an orchestrator over the verdictAttempt phases readSnapshot, resolvePipeline, checkStandingBeforeGit, resolveEffectiveImpact, checkReviewedCommit, prepareCleanSourceVerification and commit (submit_verdict.go, verdict_transition.go), with the integration evidence in verdict_integration_evidence.go and the failure and stale-verdict anomalies in verdict_failure_anomaly.go, each file under the limit.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares the state.yaml and outbox captures of PV1 (a reached approval left in the private outbox by SubmitVerdictWithAuthorityAndOptions under state-lock contention, drained by ReplayPendingVerdicts: CODE_APPROVED, outbox 1 -> 0) and PV2 (registration replaced: quarantined finding, task unchanged, outbox 1 -> 0) against goldens committed in 248bca7b1 before any production edit, generated by regen write-new on the unchanged tree. TestSupplementGoldenCoverage pins coverage; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

The verdict, pending-verdict, quarantine, rejection-RCA and reaffirm white-box tests (submit_verdict_test.go, pending_verdict_test.go, quarantined_verdict_test.go, quarantined_verdict_merge_test.go, lifecycle_verdict_authority_test.go and the other pre-existing tests) run unchanged under the race detector against the phased submitVerdict and submitVerdictLifecycle; they pin check order, error identity, quorum and provider-diversity behaviour, the rejection gate, integration evidence and result projection.

TestVerdictNamedValuesKeepTheirValues compares each K7 named value of the verdict files (submitted verdict spelling, impact key and order, RCA gate history keys, outbox directory name, mode and retry delays, failure anomaly bounds) with the literal it replaced; TestVerdictRequestPayloadKeepsItsIdentityFields pins the hashed request intent. Safe actions and effects use the delivered LifecycleSafeAction and LifecycleEffects constants, anomaly types models.AnomalyType*, orchestrator checks roles.RoleTypeOrchestrator and the delivered rejectionRCA*Key constants; persisted model fields stay strings and VerdictResult.Verdict stays string.
TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens live; none changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden against the starting commit is empty), and no older supplement golden changes.
TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the three K-VER keys are gone and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
